notes.title: Hope Harrison Demo Now Avaliable!
notes.content:
[p][b]The Hope Harrison Demo is now available to play!

Hope Harrison takes a twist on the survival horror genre and remixes it with Hand Crafted RNG, Nightmarish Monsters and Permadeath. Can you find hope?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Offering a challenge to even the most dedicated gamers. Hope Harrison will test your skills and knowledge. Find tools and supplies while you try outrun or outsmart your pursuer or pursuers. Attempt to escape from an environment that is out to kill you. Remember the Monsters could be around any corner or even behind you. Can you survive without Hope?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][h2][b][u]Multiple Unique Monsters[/u][/b][/h2][p]Face one or multiple of the many monster types each playthrough, each one with different behaviours, tactics and events. [/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Same Institute Different Spawns[/u][/b][/h2][p]The Hope Harrison Institute stays consistent every time. However every item, puzzle and monster gets randomizes each time.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Your Escape[/u][/b][/h2][p]Discover different methods of escape and delve into the dark void of the institute to recover items you need to escape.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Tracking & Hazards[/u][/b][/h2][p]Use whatever you can find to try and outwit the monsters. Hide in lockers or under furniture. Use your EMF to keep track of the monster or monsters but be careful not to run too fast you fall into one of the many traps along the way or the monster behind you.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Permadeath[/u][/b][/h2][p]Dying is permanent. Get killed and you'll be starting again. Same institute, different spawns, events and even more monsters. You better start praying.[/p]
